message.content: LiHua expresses a deep appreciation for Geralt, describing him as a complex character with a no-nonsense attitude yet a profound sense of morality. She finds his monster-slaying skills to be particularly impressive. Additionally, she highlights the depth of Geralt's character development and the choices he makes throughout the game, emphasizing the significant impact these decisions have on the narrative. LiHua also mentions the chemistry between Geralt and Yennefer, noting that their relationship adds considerable depth to the game.
